answerText:
{
"cycle": 3,
"assessment": "Current cycle-3 implementation has the core coherence/design-order model in place: deck-stage trace input covers narrative, source evidence, slide role, chart intent, semantic visual guidance, theme binding, MDPR validation refs, and review notes; chart guidance carries density and narrativeFit fields; buildDeckDesignOrderTrace now applies source backfill warnings, prerequisite checks, stage-ref namespace checks, and artifact validation.   Tests also cover stage-incompatible refs, chart narrative-fit gaps, claim-support gaps, nested order validation, and the separate source-slide evidence ledger.   The remaining local gaps are link-integrity gaps, not new design-order stages: chart placements can point to a missing or semantically wrong chart block, and source-evidence ledgers are not yet usable as first-class inputs for DeckDesignOrderTrace. External chart rendering should remain MDPR-owned; Microsoft’s Office chart reference still supports treating chart type as a data-purpose decision rather than a local renderer choice. ([Microsoft 지원][1])",
"locally_actionable_todos": [
{
"title": "Validate chart placement block identity before narrativeFit checks",
"why": "reviewChartNarrativeFit uses sourceSlideId, optional chartBlockId, and a ScientificChartIntentEntry, but the implementation only checks slide role and claim support; it does not verify that chartBlockId exists on the source/layout slide or that the mapped block is actually a chart/evidence block aligned with the intent. A stale placement can therefore pass or fail for the wrong reason.  ",
"suggested_files": [
"packages/review-core/src/index.ts",
"tests/review-core-runtime.test.ts",
"docs/ppt-visual-validation.md"
],
"acceptance": [
"Emit CHART_PLACEMENT_BLOCK_MISSING when chartBlockId is supplied but is absent from the source slide or mapped layout blocks.",
"Emit CHART_PLACEMENT_BLOCK_TYPE_MISMATCH when chartBlockId exists but is not a chart/table/image/code/diagram evidence block.",
"Optionally emit CHART_PLACEMENT_INTENT_MISMATCH when simple semantic terms from the chart block conflict with the supplied chart intent, for example a latency CDF intent mapped to a revenue table block.",
"Keep findings evidence-only with sourceSlideId, chartBlockId, chartIntent, block type, and semantic terms; do not include coordinates, raw colors, PPTX geometry, renderer object ids, or final validation verdicts.",
"Add tests for valid placement, missing chartBlockId, non-chart block mapping, and semantic mismatch while preserving the existing CHART_NARRATIVE_FIT_GAP and CHART_CLAIM_SUPPORT_MISSING tests."
]
},
{
"title": "Add a source-ledger-to-design-order bridge",
"why": "buildSourceSlideEvidenceLedger already maps slide claims to source and MDPR evidence refs, while buildDeckDesignOrderTrace still accepts sourceEvidenceRefs and narrativeSpineRefs as loose manual arrays. That leaves the source_evidence stage structurally valid but disconnected from the repo’s own evidence ledger.  ",
"suggested_files": [
"packages/review-core/src/index.ts",
"tests/review-core-runtime.test.ts",
"06_IR_CONTRACTS.md",
"docs/ppt-visual-validation.md"
],
"acceptance": [
"Expose a helper such as sourceEvidenceRefsFromLedger or buildDeckDesignOrderTraceFromLedger that derives source_evidence refs from SourceSlideEvidenceLedger entries.",
"Derived refs use only boundary-safe namespaces such as source:, evidence:, claim:, and slide:, based on source ids, paths, slide refs, and mdprEvidenceRefs; do not embed raw claim text, raw data values, coordinates, colors, or PPTX geometry.",
"When a ledger is supplied but no trace refs match it, emit a warning such as SOURCE_EVIDENCE_LEDGER_DISCONNECTED.",
"When ledger-derived refs satisfy source_evidence, do not emit DESIGN_ORDER_SOURCE_EVIDENCE_BACKFILLED because the source is independent ledger evidence, not chart-intent-derived structural evidence.",
"Add tests showing ledger-derived source evidence passes stage namespace validation and missing/disconnected ledger evidence creates a local warning."
]
}
],
"external_or_manual_todos": [],
"duplicates_or_rejected": [
"Rejected as duplicate: adding DeckDesignOrderTrace or validateReviewArtifactDesignOrder again.",
"Rejected as duplicate: re-adding nested intents/recipes validation.",
"Rejected as duplicate: re-adding densityClass, labelBudgetClass, recommendedDownshift, aggregationRequired, or narrativeFit.",
"Rejected as duplicate: re-adding EVIDENCE_CLAIM_ALIGNMENT_GAP, SEMANTIC_MOTIF_DRIFT, DESIGN_ORDER_SOURCE_EVIDENCE_BACKFILLED, DESIGN_ORDER_REF_STAGE_MISMATCH, CHART_NARRATIVE_FIT_GAP, or CHART_CLAIM_SUPPORT_MISSING.",
"Rejected as non-local: final MDPR rendering, chart primitive selection, layout, theme resolution, PPTX geometry, raw colors, raw workbook values, renderer object ids, pass/fail validation, credentials, external uploads, and manual visual inspection."
]
}

[1]: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/excel/available-chart-types-in-office?utm_source=chatgpt.com "Available chart types in Office"
